metadata.title: On the Capacity of the 2-user Gaussian MAC Interfering with a P2P Link

nodes.statement: The obtained setup consists of a point-to-point (P2P) channel interfering with with a 2-user MAC and we call it a (PIMAC).

nodes.statement: We call the resulting setup the PIMAC, whose received signals can be written as Y_1&=X_1+X_2+h_31X_3+Z_1,\\ Y_2&=h_12X_1+h_22X_2+X_3+Z_2, where h_ijinR denotes the channel coefficient from transmitter iin\1,2,3\ to receiver jin\1,2\, X_i is the transmit symbol of transmitter i and Z_j is an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) with Z_jsimN(0,1).

nodes.statement: An (n,2^nR_1,2^nR_2,2^nR_3) code for the PIMAC consists of encoding functions, decoding functions, and message sets, and induces an average probability of decoding error given by P^(n)=frac12^nR_Sigmasum_vecminM_1timesM_2timesM_3Pleft(bigcup_i=1^3E_iright), where R_Sigma=sum_i=1^3R_i and vecm=(m_1,m_2,m_3).

nodes.statement: A rate tuple (R_1,R_2,R_3) is achievable if there exists a sequence of (n,2^nR_1,2^nR_2,2^nR_3) codes such that P^(n)]to0 as ntoinfty.
